defects: Narrows Monoid G, H (gold) to Group G, H, adding an unjustified group hypothesis
Fixes the base ring to ℂ instead of keeping it a general (commutative) ring k as in the gold, losing generality

`Representation G ℂ` is ill-typed/malformed: Mathlib's `Representation` takes three type arguments (k G V) plus module instances, but here only two are supplied and V, W, U are simultaneously used as the type itself and as its terms

Uses `restrictScalars`, which is not the operation for restricting a representation along a group homomorphism (that would be composition/pullback via the homomorphism, e.g. `Representation.comp`); `restrictScalars` normally refers to changing the coefficient ring, not the acting group
`ShortExact f g` taking two raw morphisms is not the gold's categorical `ShortComplex`/`Exact` framework and does not correspond to any evident Mathlib declaration for `Representation`
Does not express restriction via a functor (resFunctor) applied to a ShortComplex as in the gold, so it fails to state the 'functor preserves and reflects exactness' formulation precisely
Drops the universe generality (w, u, v1, v2) and the Rep k G bundled category structure used in the gold
